title: Design System: Thư viện Kinh Thánh

headline.purpose: Welcome and message level-one headings; 28px at the mobile breakpoint.

body.purpose: Long-form answer reading; 15px with line height 1.75 at the mobile breakpoint.

runtime-value.purpose: Monospace runtime metadata with tabular numerals.

shadows.name: runtime-dialog
shadows.purpose: Shared diffuse elevation for runtime information, document-library and upload dialogs.

shadows.name: upload-status-bubble
shadows.purpose: Transient acknowledged cancellation or request-timeout feedback above the upload window.

motion.name: composer-border
motion.purpose: Composer focus-within stroke transition; removed under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

motion.name: upload-status-hold
motion.purpose: Status bubble stays visible before its exit; reopening upload clears the old bubble.

motion.name: upload-status-fade
motion.purpose: Fade cancellation/timeout feedback before removal; transition removed for reduced motion.

components.name: Information button
components.description: Custom header action; opens runtime configuration. The preview represents its desktop appearance.
components.css: .ds-info { height:40px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius:9px; background:hsl(var(--card)); color:hsl(var(--foreground)); font:500 13px/1 "Segoe UI",sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:none; } .ds-info:hover { background:hsl(var(--accent)); } .ds-info:focus-visible { outline:2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Composer field
components.description: Custom composer surface and textarea typography. Composer paperclip/loading controls are hidden by CSS; uploads begin from the toolbar preparation window. Native settings/submit controls are omitted from this visual fragment.
components.css: .ds-composer { background:hsl(var(--card)); border:1px solid hsl(var(--input)); border-radius:16px; padding:16px 18px 12px; transition:border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color:hsl(var(--primary)); } .ds-chat-input { width:100%; min-height:46px; font-family:"Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:16px; line-height:1.6; color:hsl(var(--foreground)); background:transparent; caret-color:hsl(var(--primary)); } .ds-chat-input::placeholder { color:hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); opacity:1; } .ds-chat-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset:3px; } @media(max-width:640px) { .ds-composer { padding:12px; } } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-composer { transition:none; animation:none; } }

components.name: Inline source reference
components.description: Numbered citation treatment. In the app, trusted mouse/keyboard activation opens the matching native Nguồn N pane; automatic opening is suppressed and a new user message resets intent. Preview href is illustrative; native source rendering is not replicated.
components.css: .ds-source { display:inline; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:6px; background:hsl(var(--accent)); color:hsl(var(--accent-foreground)); font-family:"Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:12px; font-weight:650; line-height:1.6; text-transform:none; text-decoration:none; vertical-align:baseline; } .ds-source:hover { background:hsl(var(--primary)); color:hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); } .ds-source:focus-visible { outline:2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Header book identity
components.description: Shared transparent cross-and-layered-book asset above a gray oval; no berry tile. The app loads the same SVG image for header, welcome and avatar and inverts it in dark mode. Preview inlines identical geometry for standalone rendering.
components.css: .ds-brand { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; margin-left:6px; font-family:"Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif; color:hsl(var(--foreground)); } .ds-mark { display:grid; place-items:center; width:42px; height:42px; flex-shrink:0; } .ds-logo { width:100%; height:100%; } :host-context(.dark) .ds-logo { filter:invert(1); } .ds-copy { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px; } .ds-copy strong { font-size:17px; font-weight:650; letter-spacing:-.02em; } .ds-copy > span { font-size:12px; color:hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); } @media(max-width:640px) { .ds-brand { margin-left:0; gap:8px; } .ds-mark { display:none; } .ds-copy strong { font-size:14px; max-width:120px; line-height:1.35; } .ds-copy > span { display:none; } }

components.description: Visual dialog fragment with sticky header and one metadata row; application focus/close behavior lives in about.js.

components.name: Local history item
components.description: Selected read-only snapshot row and separate removal action. App timestamps come from saved browser-local history; the preview has no storage callbacks.

components.name: Read-only transcript
components.description: Saved plain-text reading surface. App reader overlays grid row 3, retains the mounted live panel underneath, and restores no model context or attachments.
components.html:
Tình yêu trong Kinh Thánh

Bản lưu trên trình duyệt để xem lại. Nguồn đính kèm và ngữ cảnh cho mô hình không được khôi phục.

Trợ lý

Nội dung văn bản đã lưu trên trình duyệt.

narrative.overview:
Restrained berry ink gives this Vietnamese Scripture workspace its identity. Pale tinted surroundings and distinct reading surfaces support long answers and source inspection. The serif welcome heading is modest; the working interface uses a sans-serif face.

This is an extracted record of the implemented frontend, not a replacement component library. public/about.css owns the visual overrides, including its final cascade; public/about.js owns the inserted identity, welcome copy and runtime information dialog, and dynamically imports public/workspace.js for the function bar and local history reader. The workspace imports public/document-library.js for the document-library modal and friendly initial chat introduction, public/document-upload.js for upload presentation, and public/source-view.js for explicit citation-open behavior. .chainlit/config.toml loads the entry files and shared transparent SVG logo, chooses Vietnamese and defaults to light mode. Chainlit continues to own the live chat panels, native action callbacks, upload picker/validation, source rendering, settings and menus. chainlit.md and .chainlit/translations/vi.json provide interface text.
keyCharacteristics: Berry accents on a pale light shell, with a separate charcoal and rose dark theme.
Segoe UI reading and controls, with Georgia reserved for top-level reading headings.
Recognizable inline source references that open Chainlit's existing source surface on explicit activation.
Quiet borders, restrained corners and a shared modal shadow.
A separate function bar and local, read-only transcript history around the live chat.
A dedicated document-library modal that presents existing catalog content and actions.
A compact upload window that keeps file preparation, progress and results together.

rules.name: The Paired Theme Rule
rules.body: Apply each semantic interface color through the existing CSS variable so switching the root dark class changes the entire pairing together. The shared SVG logo retains its asset fills and uses image inversion in dark mode.

rules.name: The Reading Heading Rule
rules.body: Keep the serif treatment on the implemented welcome and message level-one headings; preserve sans-serif type for the working controls and body.

dos: Do use the paired semantic CSS variables for both themes.
Do keep source links visibly distinct and open their native panes only after explicit citation activation.
Do retain keyboard focus outlines and the mobile information action's accessible name.
Do preserve the final CSS cascade when consulting earlier declarations.
Do keep the local reader's read-only limitation visible and retain a clear return to the current conversation.
Do keep the session-start qualifier beside the document-library vector count and forward summary/delete actions through their existing native controls.
Do keep history close and reopen actions available at every width with synchronized accessible state.
Do keep upload progress and validation inside the upload window and wait for native cancellation acknowledgement before reporting completion.
donts: Don't expand the serif heading treatment into body text or working controls.
Don't treat the light palette as the dark palette or restore the removed berry tile behind the shared transparent logo.
Don't infer new native component states, dimensions or callbacks from these custom overrides.
Don't introduce illustrations, paper textures or decorative motion into this recorded visual direction.
Don't imply that a browser snapshot restores model context, attachments or an account-synchronized conversation.
Don't present the startup vector count as live statistics or restore recognized catalog-management output to the chat transcript.
Don't infer a persisted desktop history preference or replace the native source renderer with a custom pane.
Don't bypass native upload limits or imply that closing preparation cancels an upload already being processed.
